slido1.titleEnHtml:
Grab your phone—
let's meet you first
slido1.titleZh: 拿出手機，先認識一下你
slido1.subEn: Scan the QR to join　slido.com　·　#
slido1.noteEn: Coming up: your department, what AI feels most like to you, and how you actually use AI.
slido1.noteZh: 等等問你：你的系所、AI 對你來說最像什麼、你平常怎麼用 AI

phases.titleZh: 這門課在學什麼：三部曲
phases.noteEnHtml: Zero prerequisites—no coding, Git, or command-line background needed; every week runs Make → Test/Break → Make it yours.
phases.noteZh: 零先修——不要求程式設計、Git 或命令列背景；每週固定走 Make → Test／Break → Make it yours

items.bodyEn: Tell tools, teammates, workflows and agents apart; make images, a web app, version safety, and source-backed research. Midterm = W1–7.
items.bodyZh: 分辨工具、隊友、工作流與 Agent；做出圖像、web app、版本安全與來源查證。期中範圍＝第 1–7 週。

items.bodyEn: What counts as a real agent; task contracts, action preview, permissions, logs and recovery; agent-assisted data analysis.
items.bodyZh: 什麼才算真正的 Agent；任務契約、動作預覽、權限、log 與復原；Agent 輔助資料分析。

items.bodyEn: One final piece: a task contract, two iterations, sources and tests, red-teaming and repair—shown at the showcase.
items.bodyZh: 收成一件作品：任務契約、兩次迭代、來源與測試、紅隊與修復，在成果節展出。

destination.titleEnHtml:
Where this course leads:
an AI workflow you can keep in check
destination.titleZh: 這門課的終點：一個你管得住的 AI 工作流
destination.subEn: Not memorizing tool names—turning a real problem into work you can build, back with evidence, and keep under control.
destination.subZh: 不是背工具名稱，而是把一個真實問題，變成做得出來、查得到證據、也管得住的作品。

weeks.legendEn: ●=weekly topic　●=midterm/final milestone　·　bands=the three parts　｜　每週主題・里程碑・三部曲分段

grading.noteEnHtml: Final = an AI workflow project: at least one main and one supporting AI capability, three tests, and one failure-and-recovery. You may build on earlier work—brand count, technical difficulty and public deployment earn no extra points.
grading.noteZh: 期末＝AI 工作流專題：至少一項主要與一項輔助 AI 能力、三筆測試、一次失敗與復原；可沿用深化先前作品，品牌數量、技術難度與公開部署不加分。

tools.noteEnHtml: Tools change, skills don't. We grade tasks, evidence, permissions, verification and recovery—never product interfaces.　工具會換、能力不換。

daily.titleZh: 日常 AI 工具推薦
daily.noteEnHtml: Pick one that fits you—this course never requires accounts or payment.　挑一個順手的就好，這門課不要求辦帳號、不用付費。

items.enHtml: A laptop or tablet (laptop recommended)—no device? Paper and pre-generated equivalents count the same
items.zh: 筆電或平板（建議筆電）；沒有裝置也有等值路徑

items.enHtml: No AI accounts, no payment—every core activity has an account-free path (your school account covers e-Learning & Zuvio)
items.zh: 不用先辦 AI 帳號、不用付費——學校帳號就夠用（e學苑交作業、Zuvio 點名）

items.enHtml: Room E403—seats near outlets go first-come
items.zh: 教室 理工二館 E403——有插座的位子先到先選

rules.titleEn: How we use AI in this course
rules.titleZh: 這門課的 AI 使用守則
rules.subEn: You may learn and create with AI—but you must:
rules.subZh: 可以用 AI 學習與創作，但你要——

items.bodyEn: Be able to say how you asked, how you revised, and why you decided that way.
items.bodyZh: 說得出你怎麼問、怎麼改、為什麼這樣決定。

items.headZh: 會查證 AI 的輸出
items.bodyEn: AI gets things wrong and makes things up; check before you hand it in.
items.bodyZh: AI 會錯也會編；交出去前你要查過。

items.headZh: 守學術誠信與安全底線
items.bodyEn: Honor integrity, privacy and copyright; use only public or synthetic data.
items.bodyZh: 遵守誠信、隱私與著作權；只用公開或合成資料。

slido2.titleEnHtml:
Last thing—
tell me what you hope for
slido2.noteEnHtml: Why you're taking this, one problem you want AI to help you solve, and one word for your hopes.
slido2.noteZh: 修課動機、你最想讓 AI 幫你解決的問題、一個詞形容你的期待
